[Immune to Alter]” '''What changed:''' The ▼ sentence (“Once per turn, may ▼ Hutt Influence, Bib, or a barge.”) moved to the front; “[Reflections III] Leia’s game text is canceled” became “[Reflections III] Leia may not cancel Force drains (or reduce your total ability)”; “may activate 1 Force” became “you may activate 1 Force”. The PC card data (swccg-card-json) and the PC card list never took this change: they still give the original wording. The card image prints the errata mark “E1” at bottom right.
